result.summary: The street features continuous sidewalks on both sides and a marked crosswalk at the foreground intersection. While the environment is generally pedestrian-friendly with street trees and lighting, the wide roadway and on-street parking may create visibility issues and encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Visibility obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right side of the street can obscure pedestrians, especially children, from the view of oncoming drivers near the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb.

hazards.name: Wide travel lane
hazards.description: The single travel lane appears wide, which can lead to higher vehicle speeds in a residential/mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks with curb ramps and tactile paving at an alley intersection. While a bike lane and street lighting are present, the lack of marked crosswalks across the main roadway and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk across the main street at this junction, which may lead to unpredictable pedestrian movements and driver confusion.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A parked vehicle on the right side of the street may obstruct the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic or vehicles exiting the alley.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the alley entrance

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility (continental) crosswalk markings across the main street to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement 'daylighting' by removing the parking space immediately adjacent to the alley entrance to improve sightlines for all users.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with continuous sidewalks and parallel parking on both sides, which provides a buffer for pedestrians. A marked crosswalk is visible at the intersection ahead, though parked cars may obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block the view between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street leading up to the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide, newly paved sidewalk and a marked zebra crosswalk at a residential intersection. The street appears to be a low-volume, one-way residential road, though it lacks physical buffers between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

hazards.name: Utility pole at corner
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is located directly at the curb radius, potentially obstructing sightlines between drivers and pedestrians preparing to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk near the 'Do Not Enter' sign

hazards.name: Blank brick wall
hazards.description: A long stretch of blank wall along the sidewalk reduces natural surveillance and visual interest, which can impact perceived safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the sidewalk

hazards.name: Degraded road surface
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven pavement near the drainage grate could pose a minor trip hazard or affect stability for those crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by extending the sidewalk into the parking lane at the corner.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to enhance pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install dedicated lighting fixtures at a lower height to ensure the sidewalk and crosswalk are well-illuminated.
